module: Flowgraph node 'Camera Look at Position' (repeat_instant category, file cameraAutoRotate). Switches to the free camera and orients the camera to constantly look at the target position 'position', without moving it (up vector (0,0,1)).
notes: Crashes if the 'position' pin is nil (vec3(nil)).
The setPosRot call uses player index 0.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (created by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

work.desc: Enables the free camera if needed then applies core_camera.setPosRot with the rotation quatFromDir(position - camPos, up).
